name: entrenoapp
description: EntrenoApp - Tu entrenador personal de fitness. iOS app empaquetada con Capacitor.

scripts.test: npm run test:workouts && npm run test:app
scripts.test:workouts: node scripts/test-workout-history.js && node scripts/test-logging-safety.js && node scripts/test-rest-timer.js && node scripts/test-daily-workout.js && node scripts/test-workout-budget.js && node scripts/test-workout-metrics.js && node scripts/test-workout-draft.js && node scripts/test-growth-tracking.js && node scripts/test-analytics-retry.js
scripts.test:app: node scripts/test-settings-navigation.js && node scripts/test-settings-ui.js && node scripts/test-welcome-workout.js && node scripts/test-next-workout.js && node scripts/test-daily-home.js && node scripts/test-exercise-muscles.js && node scripts/test-exercise-illustrations.js && node scripts/test-exercise-visuals.js && node scripts/test-generated-exercise-media.js && node scripts/test-session-summary-i18n.js && node scripts/test-history-progress-ui.js && node scripts/test-notification-opt-in.js && node scripts/test-backup.js && node scripts/test-store-listing.js
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
